definitions.gloss: to substitute, to replace with, to use in place of
definitions.explanation: To use one thing in place of another. The focus is on providing a substitute or alternative for something.

examples.japanese: バターをマーガリンに{代|か}えた。
{挨拶|あいさつ}に{代|か}えて、メールを{送|おく}った。
examples.english: I sent an email in lieu of a formal greeting.

examples.japanese: {書面|しょめん}をもって{報告|ほうこく}に{代|か}えさせていただきます。
examples.english: Please allow this written document to serve in place of a verbal report.

notes:
{代|か}える is a transitive ichidan verb meaning to substitute or replace with something. The intransitive pair is {代|か}わる.

TRANSITIVITY:
・Type: transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
・Pair: {代|か}わる (intransitive — to take the place of)
・Pattern: AをBに{代|か}える (to substitute B for A)

ASPECT (ている):
・{代|か}えている = has substituted, is using as a substitute (resulting state)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・AをBに{代|か}える (to substitute B for A)
・〜に{代|か}えて (in place of, instead of)
・{挨拶|あいさつ}に{代|か}える (to serve as a greeting)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{代|か}える: to substitute, to use as a replacement for
・{変|か}える: to change, to alter (modify something's state)
・{換|か}える / {替|か}える: to exchange, to swap (interchangeable items)

cross_references.notes: 変える means to change or alter — different kanji, different meaning
帰る means to return home — same reading, unrelated meaning
